scope: Exploratory comparison on tuning split only; not final evaluation or Orin
preprocessing: same project load_h5/preprocess as prior training/evaluation
depth_units: native mirror units; conversion chain not independently verified
metric_notes: positive finite target mask; pooled pixel metrics; equal-weight mean-image and mean-scene RMSE; nonpositive predictions handled by DepthMetrics
limitations: Exploratory tuning comparison, one seed and one epoch. Pruning width chosen after inspecting previous tuning results; checkpoint pretraining overlap and scene independence are unverified. No Orin timing or generalization claim. Alpha 0.1 chosen after inspecting the initial tuning results; follow-up is post-hoc.

baseline.description: Existing community-mirrored already-pruned baseline and teacher

pruned_before_recovery.description: Same baseline with 200 to 192 first-decoder channels using downstream weight scoring

supervised_control.description: Same pruned starting model, supervised-only recovery

distilled_student.description: Same pruned starting model, ground-truth and teacher loss weighted equally

distilled_alpha01.description: Post-hoc smaller teacher weight after alpha 0.5 underperformed
